name: Baked Honey Mustard-Miso Salmon with Mixed Veggie & Almond Slaw

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 230°C (450°F). Coat a large baking dish with a thin layer of oil and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
3 red bell peppers
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger; place in a large bowl along with miso, dressing, water, and oil. Whisk to combine the glaze.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup miso paste, white
⅓ cup honey mustard dressing
⅓ cup water
1 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Pat salmon dry with paper towels, place in the baking dish, and drizzle with half of the glaze. (Reserve bowl with remaining glaze for later use.)
Place baking dish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until salmon is cooked through, 10-15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, add additional dressing and oil to the bowl with the remaining glaze; whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup honey mustard dressing
1 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and medium dice cucumbers; add to the bowl.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces; add to the bowl.
Add broccoli slaw and almonds to the bowl, then toss to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (340 g) pkgs broccoli slaw
⅓ cup almonds, sliced

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salmon and slaw between plates. Enjoy!
